title: 학습된 C2MS 가중치의 저랭크·depthwise 분해와 짧은 미세조정
hypothesis: 65 C2MS_L1S의 원래 해상도 backbone을 랭크 32 병목으로, W2 가지를 1x1·depthwise 3x3·1x1(CP 랭크 384 또는 256)로 분해한 뒤 65 손실로 짧게 미세조정하면, 연산 51-86%에서 65번과 같은 validation 정확도를 회복하고, 사영(K10)을 붙여 같은 시드 C2MS보다 RR 세 지표가 좋아진다.

evidence.stage0_lowrank_no_finetune: QB seed 42, 53 C2MS: backbone rank 32 test -0.063 dB (86% conv MACs), rank 24 -0.262 dB; W2 bottleneck rank 96 -0.248 dB, rank 64 -0.731 dB (activation-aware SVD); 65 C2MS_L1S the same pattern (provenance/stage0/lowrank_s42.json)
evidence.stage0_cp_no_finetune: W2 CP rank 512 -0.076 dB (95%), 384 -0.318 dB (80%), 256 -1.114 dB (65%) vs weight-space bottleneck rank 96 -1.178 dB (provenance/stage0/cp_test.json)
evidence.stage0_short_finetune: backbone rank 32 + W2 CP 384 (66%, 1,873,402 used parameters): -0.400 dB after factorization -> -0.045 dB / SAM +0.027 deg after 750 steps of batch 16 (C2MS MSE loss, lr 5e-5 cosine, about 0.7 epoch); CP 256 (51%): -1.186 -> -0.190 dB after 250 steps (stopped) (provenance/stage0/ft_test.json, ft_test.log). Local MPS, QB seed 42 only, post-hoc on test
evidence.stage0_from_scratch_mimic: depthwise blocks trained from scratch to imitate the trained W2 output converged much slower than plain blocks (1500 steps: plain 64x8 -2.36 dB, inverted residual 128x8 -4.08 dB); weak evidence (provenance/stage0/mimic.json)
evidence.result_81: 65 C2MS_L1S + projection vs same-seed C2MS, 3 seeds: QB +0.072, GF2 +0.191, WV3 +0.130 dB (improvement); K10 projection equal to the full projection within 0.0003 dB
evidence.result_80: a W2 branch trained from scratch at 64x16 kept 94-103% of the C2MS gain on QB/GF2 but only 54-63% on WV3 (8 bands)

arms.FT0: 65 C2MS_L1S unchanged + the same fine-tuning (control for the fine-tuning itself)
arms.K1: backbone 8 convs 64->64 3x3 -> 3x3 64->32 (no bias) + 1x1 32->64; activation-aware truncated SVD over 512 training patches
arms.K2: K1 + W2 16 convs 128->128 3x3 -> 1x1 128->384 (no bias), depthwise 3x3 (384), 1x1 384->128; CP-ALS rank 384, 150 iterations, seed 0, balanced factors

stage0_cost_qb.note: local count; recounted per sensor by run.py optimize

loss: 65 loss: original per-pixel L1 + 1.0 x per-pixel L1 on 2x coarser pairs + 0.46 x spectral loss on the original pair (history fields train_mse/coarse_train_mse hold mean absolute errors)
ema_note: EMA recorded only (as 65); selection uses the online weights
schedule: Adam lr = 1e-6 + 0.5 * (5e-5 - 1e-6) * (1 + cos(pi * zero_based_epoch / (E - 1))), E = 10 (K2L 40); epoch 0 validation is the factorized model before any update
projection: prepare.Projected: the 45/66 observation-consistency projection with the test sensor's Wald operator, conjugate gradient stopped at 10 iterations (K10, 81)

transfer_tests.WV2: WV3-trained runs are also evaluated on WV2 (reference only under v2.4)

gate.basis: validation only (selected weights vs the same-seed 65 checkpoint the arm started from); test is never used for the gate
gate.note: the lightest passing arm goes to stage 2; FT0 is a control and is never chosen; if no arm passes, stage 2 is not run

comparisons.official: chosen arm + K10 projection vs plain same-seed C2MS (QB 53, GF2/WV3 54), per training sensor, 3-seed mean, criteria v2.4 (RR only, threshold 0.04 dB); the experiment is an improvement only if QB, GF2 and WV3 all are
comparisons.lightweight_reference: arm + P vs 65 + P (same weights before factorization): 3-seed mean RR PSNR at or above -0.04 dB is reported as lightweight non-inferiority (not a judgement)
comparisons.fine_tuning_control: arm vs FT0 (stage 1, seed 42): separates the effect of fine-tuning from factorization
comparisons.cost: used parameters, conv GMAC at 256x256 and GPU time at 256 and 512 (with and without K10 projection), seed 42

stages.0: local diagnostics (provenance/stage0), post-hoc on the QB test; not a judgement
stages.1: QB and WV3, seed 42, five arms, two trainings at once, then evaluation and the validation gate
stages.2: the chosen arm on QB, GF2, WV3 x seeds 42-44 (the stage-1 runs are reused), then the 3-seed summary
stages.3: optional, user decision after stage 2: the chosen structure trained from scratch for 150 epochs (QB seed 42) to separate structure from initialization

not_run.K2P: fine-tuning through the projection was planned but is not run: with the evaluation margin of 5 MS pixels the projection constrains only 6x6 of the 16x16 MS pixels of a 64x64 training patch, so its training definition would differ from inference; left for a later experiment

expected_duration: stage 1 about 3-4 h (QB 5 arms, 80 epochs in total; WV3 about half the steps), evaluations about 1.5 h; stage 2 about 3-4 h
limits: stage 0 numbers are post-hoc on the QB test (local, seed 42) and only motivated the arms; the gate uses validation
QB has shown validation gains that did not reach the test (59, 73); the fine-tuning is kept short and FT0 is the control
depthwise convolutions may not be faster on the GPU in proportion to MACs; GPU time is reported
precision: FP16 AMP training with GradScaler; FP32 loss, validation and evaluation; factorization in float64 on the CPU
scenes_note: fixed QB scene indices reused on GF2, WV3 and WV2 (as 65/80); images for seed 42 only
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch 0 (the factorized model before fine-tuning; for FT0 the 65 weights), earliest exact tie; test never used for selection
result_summary: validation 관문으로 고른 K2(backbone 랭크 32 + W2 CP 384, 연산 66%, 실사용 파라미터 68%) + 사영이 같은 시드 C2MS 대비 3시드 평균 QB +0.051 dB·SAM −0.100°·ERGAS −0.018, GF2 +0.157 dB·−0.024°·−0.014, WV3 +0.119 dB·−0.085°·−0.015로 세 센서 모두 개선이며 기준 모델 교체 조건을 충족합니다(자동 교체 안 함). 분해 전 65번 + 사영 대비 −0.012에서 −0.034 dB(경량 비열등)입니다. 다만 RTX 3060 Ti에서 K2의 GPU 시간은 depthwise 합성곱 때문에 C2MS보다 31-37% 깁니다(256² 19.1 → 25.0 ms). K3(51%)는 관문에서 탈락했습니다.
